interactions.teaches: How a true story film changes events, and the difference between invented and moved details.
interactions.studentAction: Call ten claims History, Hollywood or Remixed.
interactions.feedback: A stamp and the real record appear under each claim, with a running score and the total the film changed.
interactions.staticFallback: Every verdict is plain text after a button press, with no animation needed.
interactions.identityFit: Ticket stub cream cards with rubber stamps.

interactions.teaches: Compare the actor and the athlete side by side.
interactions.studentAction: Play the trailer and the 1976 news film.
interactions.feedback: Two players open in place, framed in different plate colors.
interactions.staticFallback: Each video also has an Open on YouTube link.

interactions.teaches: The scale of the normal route to the NFL.
interactions.feedback: 1,000 dots narrow to 73 college players and 1 draft pick, with a reading line for each step.
interactions.staticFallback: The reading line carries every number.

interactions.teaches: Patterns across ten routes: what opened the door.
interactions.studentAction: Pick one of eight doors or tap a route number.
interactions.feedback: Routes and list items outside that door dim, and a sentence names who went through it.
interactions.staticFallback: The list with names, routes and years is always visible and every badge is a link.
interactions.identityFit: Numbered route tree on a field.

interactions.teaches: How the draft misjudged talent across eras.
interactions.studentAction: Switch four views of the board.
interactions.feedback: Dots fade in or out and a reading line explains each view.
interactions.staticFallback: The four fact boxes and reading line hold every number.
interactions.identityFit: Pick number axis and a never drafted lot.

interactions.teaches: Students connect their own goal to a historical route.
interactions.studentAction: Fill five fields and pick a route.
interactions.feedback: A comic card redraws with their words and the chosen route in its color.
interactions.staticFallback: Inputs remain readable as a form without the card.

interactions.teaches: Argue with evidence from the universes.
interactions.identityFit: Cream answer cards with comic question numbers.

interactions.teaches: Real footage carries the real people's likeness.
interactions.studentAction: Tap a frame to load the video.
interactions.feedback: The facade becomes a YouTube player.
interactions.staticFallback: Each universe stands alone in text.
interactions.identityFit: Dotted projector frames in the universe palette.

interactions.teaches: Distinguish original photographic evidence from the surface details invented during overpainting.
interactions.studentAction: Use the native keyboard/touch range to uncover the original source, or open its source disclosure.
interactions.feedback: The original photograph replaces the illustration with a percent description; a dated note identifies what the source can establish.
interactions.staticFallback: Native details always exposes the source photograph and limits without JavaScript; reduced motion uses identical instant reveal.
interactions.identityFit: Two visual layers of the same evidence frame, real captions and fine ink rules.

interactions.teaches: A likeness photograph, a source-derived interpretation and a reconstructed scene have different evidentiary limits.
interactions.studentAction: Open three native disclosures that question what each image can prove, then follow its link back to the relevant historical account.
interactions.feedback: Each answer identifies the source date, what the image establishes and what the storyteller added.
interactions.staticFallback: Native details works without JavaScript, with keyboard and touch; no animation or saved response is required.
interactions.identityFit: Authentic source photos and a labeled reconstruction are compared as three evidence cards, with creators, licenses and explicit limits.
